name: Forged Steel Bars
summary: In the northern Barrens, Thun'grim Firegaze's steel bars are missing. Recovering them will prove a warrior's resolve to reclaim stolen property.

sections.title: Stolen Metal
sections.body: Thun'grim Firegaze, a visually impaired orc smith, keeps a camp in the northern Barrens. Razormane quilboar took his iron chest during a night raid, distracting him with grunts and snorts while thieves slipped away. Unable to work fine steel, the quilboar left the unopened chest near a ruined wagon in their encampment to the northwest. The bars remain intact for warriors willing to recover them.

faq.q: Who owns these forged steel bars?
faq.answer: The bars belong to Thun'grim Firegaze, an orc armorer and weaponsmith who lives in a camp in the northern Barrens.

faq.q: Why did the quilboar steal them?
faq.answer: The Razormane quilboar stole them to pillage Thun'grim's valuables. Knowing his eyesight was poor, they taunted and distracted him while others carried off his iron chest.

faq.q: Did the quilboar use the steel?
aliases: what did quilboar do with steel
faq.answer: No. The Razormanes lacked the skill to work such finely refined steel. They left the chest unopened beside a broken wagon in their camp.

faq.q: What will Thun'grim offer in return for them?
aliases: what do i get for the steel
faq.answer: Thun'grim offers aspiring warriors a crafted weapon in exchange for braving the quilboar camps and returning all the bars.

angles.text: Recovering Thun'grim's stolen steel proves a warrior can track down thieves and face dangerous quilboar packs. In return, Thun'grim offers custom weaponry.
The refined bars show the difference between crude tribal scrap metal and the quality steel made by trained Horde smiths.
